notes: In 5.2, cu-omit-content-field-retention becomes cu-date-field-normalization because the analyzer reference and GA REST reference conflict on omitContent field retention. cu-text-extraction-layout-retention becomes cu-document-category-fallback because detailed text-only layout behavior lacked explicit GA verification and risked a name giveaway. The remaining planned facts are retained. Semantic configuration eligibility uses the current unmarked field requirements, with configuration availability corroborated in GA Search Service REST API 2026-04-01; preview examples and properties are excluded.

cards.statement: An Azure AI Search app uses search with vectorQueries to merge keyword and vector results in one request.
cards.explanation: Azure AI Search runs the text and vector query paths in parallel, then combines their ranked results using Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

source.title: Hybrid search using vectors and full-text search in Azure AI Search

cards.statement: An Azure AI Search app uses semantic reranking to fetch documents missed by its first retrieval stage.
cards.explanation: Semantic ranker reorders documents supplied by initial retrieval. Increase the initial candidate set when relevant documents are missing.
cards.misconception: Semantic reranking retrieves additional documents that the initial search missed.

source.title: Semantic ranking in Azure AI Search

cards.statement: Azure AI Search writes fresh wording for the app's returned semantic answers using a generative language model.
cards.explanation: Azure AI Search semantic answers extract verbatim passages from indexed documents. The source text needs to contain an answer-like passage.
cards.misconception: Semantic answers generate a new answer from the retrieved content.

source.title: Return a semantic answer in Azure AI Search

cards.statement: An Azure AI Search developer maps the OCR skill's image input to /document/normalized_images/*.
cards.explanation: Set indexer imageAction to generateNormalizedImages so the enrichment tree contains the image objects consumed by the OCR skill.

source.title: OCR cognitive skill

cards.statement: An Azure AI Search app maps contentOffset to the Text Merge skill's offsets input to place embedded-image OCR text.
cards.explanation: Text Merge uses image contentOffset values to insert OCR text into the original document body alongside surrounding text.

source.title: Text Merge cognitive skill

cards.statement: Azure AI Search pairs Custom Web API skill outputs with inputs by their positions in the values arrays.
cards.explanation: Azure AI Search correlates custom skill records by recordId. A Web API returns the input recordId with its corresponding enrichment even when response records arrive in a different order.
cards.misconception: The request and response array positions identify the same custom skill record.

source.title: Custom Web API skill in an Azure AI Search enrichment pipeline

cards.statement: Azure AI Search index projections can repeat a parent document's title on its chunk documents.
cards.explanation: Map /document/title in the projection selector alongside the chunk content. Search results then carry the source title on the chunk documents.

source.title: Define an index projection for parent-child indexing

cards.statement: An Azure AI Search app treats equal vector dimensions as sufficient for mixing query and document embedding models.
cards.explanation: Use the same embedding model for document indexing and query vectors in Azure AI Search. Equal dimensions alone do not align the models' representations.
cards.misconception: Matching vector lengths makes different embedding models interchangeable for retrieval.

source.title: Generate embeddings for search queries and documents

cards.statement: An Azure AI Search app favors preFilter over postFilter when a selective vector-query filter causes missing matches.
cards.explanation: preFilter evaluates the filter during HNSW traversal. This avoids the false negatives that shard-level postFilter can introduce for selective filters.

source.title: Add a filter to a vector query in Azure AI Search

cards.statement: An Azure AI Search developer can add a retrievable string field with searchable=false to a semantic configuration.
cards.explanation: Semantic configuration inputs are searchable, retrievable string fields. Set searchable=true on the text field before using it for semantic ranking.
cards.misconception: A retrievable string field is eligible for semantic ranking even when full-text search is disabled.

source.title: Configure semantic ranker and return captions in search results

cards.statement: Content Understanding 2025-11-01 document analyzers enable OCR by default for an app's scanned PDFs.
cards.explanation: A document analyzer's enableOcr setting defaults to true. It extracts text from scanned pages and image-based PDFs.
tags: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

source.title: What is a Content Understanding analyzer?

cards.statement: Content Understanding 2025-11-01 requires a customer LLM deployment for an app's prebuilt-layout calls.
cards.explanation: prebuilt-layout performs content and layout extraction without a customer language model or embedding model deployment.
cards.misconception: The layout analyzer depends on a customer-provided LLM deployment.
tags: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools
cards.volatilityNote: The model requirements of prebuilt analyzers can evolve as the service changes.

source.title: Prebuilt analyzers in Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

cards.statement: A Content Understanding 2025-11-01 app polls the Operation-Location URL for its asynchronous document result.
cards.explanation: The Analyze POST returns an operation URL. Poll that URL until the result's status is Succeeded before consuming the extracted document fields.
tags: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

source.title: Quickstart: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

cards.statement: Content Understanding 2025-11-01 keeps an invoice's spelled-out month names in the app's valueDate result.
cards.explanation: A date-typed Content Understanding field returns valueDate in ISO 8601 format, YYYY-MM-DD. The value uses a normalized representation rather than the invoice's original formatting.
cards.misconception: The typed date value preserves the source document formatting.
tags: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

source.title: Content Analyzers - Get Result

cards.statement: A Content Understanding 2025-11-01 app defines each line-item column in an array's items.properties.
cards.explanation: An analyzer's line-item schema uses type:array with items of type:object. The object's properties describe the values to extract for a line.
tags: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

source.title: What is a Content Understanding analyzer?

cards.statement: Content Understanding 2025-11-01 sends an unfamiliar document to an implicit other category.
cards.explanation: An app defines an explicit catch-all category for unmatched documents. Otherwise, Content Understanding assigns a category from the app's configured list.
cards.misconception: The classifier creates a fallback category for documents outside the configured categories.
tags: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

source.title: Content Understanding classification/segmentation

cards.statement: An app locates a PDF field's supporting region from its source string in Content Understanding 2025-11-01.
cards.explanation: A document field's source encodes its page number and spatial coordinates. A review UI uses this data to highlight the supporting PDF region.
tags: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

source.title: Document Analysis: Extract Structured Content with Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

cards.statement: A custom Content Understanding 2025-11-01 analyzer supplies generated field confidence by default.
cards.explanation: Generated document fields have opt-in confidence scores. Set estimateFieldSourceAndConfidence for the analyzer or estimateSourceAndConfidence for a field.
cards.misconception: Adding generated document fields enables confidence scoring by default.
tags: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

source.title: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools document solutions

cards.statement: An app can preserve merged cells with tableFormat:html in Content Understanding 2025-11-01 document output.
cards.explanation: HTML table output preserves complex cell structures. GitHub Flavored Markdown table syntax lacks support for merged cells and rich headers.
tags: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

source.title: Content Analyzers - Get

cards.statement: An app can fix recurring OCR character errors with labeled samples in Content Understanding 2025-11-01.
cards.explanation: Labeled samples guide document field extraction with domain examples. They do not retrain text recognition to repair recurring OCR character errors.
cards.misconception: Correcting field labels also repairs the underlying OCR recognizer.
tags: Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

source.title: Validate document analyzer quality with confidence, grounding, and labeled samples
